observations: Rendered header exposes broad category search selector and dedicated account/cart links; department menus group tool categories and industries, with About, Presets, Support, Where to Buy, and Services.

Homepage layers a two-slide hero, impact-tool compare shelf with price/rating/stock states, sale and services tiles, top collections, featured product with inventory and purchase controls, best-seller shelf, countdown promotion, five-way category navigation, DIY articles, service/footer promises.
Read-only browser render; no navigation/product controls activated. Seller certifications, orders, shipping and availability claims unverified.
By Category is a department directory rather than a conventional product grid: Featured, Popular Tools, Hand Tools, Hardware, Storage & Workspace and Accessories each expose nested category links.
No product count, product filters or sort controls are exposed on this directory page; browsing controls not activated.

Compact Impact Wrench PDP shows ten media items, $180, BAT20CW SKU, low-stock label, product description, quantity, Add to cart/Buy it now, shipping estimate and specifications/request-a-quote accordions.
Visible demo notice links purchasing to Klein Tools; no purchase, quantity, media or accordion action executed. Stock, rating, torque and fulfillment claims remain unverified.
Dedicated cart page reports an empty cart, offers Continue shopping, shows a free-shipping threshold and order processing copy; no cart changes or checkout.

limits: Homepage, By Category and Compact Impact Wrench were already indexed; browser observations remain separate from indexed-document fields.
No shopper controls, filters, sorting, add-to-cart, cart mutation, checkout, screenshot, measured viewport/mobile, Theme Editor, keyboard or performance test.
Demo claims about certification, sales, product specifications, stock and shipping remain unverified.
